sentences.text: Shri Ravi Ballabh Tripathi - Advocate for the petitioner.

Shri Vijay Sundaram - Public Prosecutor for the respondent 
 Prosecutor.
 Shri Sheeshu Yadav - Advocate for the respondent No.2/compl
 Order

The present petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 528 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashment of FIR dated 26.04.2022 bearing Crime No.202/2022 registered at Police Station Hazira, District Gwalior for the offences punishable under Section 363 of IPC and all other consequential proceedings including charge sheet and trial being case No.112/2022 pending before 11th Addl. Sessions judge Gwalior on the basis of compromise between the victim and the applicant.

2 . It is the submission of counsel for the petitioner that both the parties had entered into compromise and now the parties want to settle the matter amicably by way of compromise.
Therefore, applications by way of I.A. No.17855/2024 and I.A.No.17857/2024 have been preferred under Section 359 of BNSS read with Section 320 of Cr.P.C. by the petitioner and the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:16178 2 MCRC-36894-2024 complainant.
Parties fairly submit that they want to give peace a chance and for that they want to settle their dispute inter se.
3. In the case in hand, it appears that the petitioner is facing allegations of offence under Section 363, 376, 506 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of POCSO Act.

Petitioner and prosecutrix now intend to Veeru Alias Virendra Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31125796/
1 settle the matter by way of compromise.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. From the pleadings, it has nowhere mentioned that the petitioner and prosecutrix are living as legally wedded couple.
Therefore, looking to the nature of allegations, which involve commission of heinous offence of rape, trial is to be concluded.
Therefore, this case is not in the nature of settlement.
Petitioner has to plead and prove his part of innocence before the trial court as per law.

Accordingly, I.A. No.17855/2024 and I.A.No.17857/2024 as well as the present petition is dismissed.
5 . Needless to say that evidence led by the parties shall be duly appreciated by the trial court and all these aspects shall be taken care of by the trial Court.
(ANAND PATHAK) JUDGE SP Veeru Alias Virendra Singh Kushwah vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31125796/
